name: Compelling
body:
Weaving tall tales and spinning yarns is something you do quickly and naturally.

Prerequisites: Piper, Deceitful.

Benefit: You can make a Bluff check that would normally be a standard or full round action as a move action. You may do this a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Charisma modifier (minimum 1).
